property_summary: For all caller addresses, the original contract allows only the deployer (owner) to successfully call sudicideAnyone (call returns/succeeds only when msg.sender == owner); the mutant inverts the check so some non-owner caller(s) can succeed while the real owner is rejected, so there exists a caller for which success differs between versions.
change_summary: Change the require to the opposite condition so only non-owners can call functions with this modifier (msg.sender != __owner).
